summary:
Meeting #40 — Pipeline Dashboard Scoped + Quick Wins Assigned.

Team held standup #40 (6 participants). Key decisions:

1. Pipeline Dashboard (TPI-2): Three read-only cards on index.html above team roster — active pipelines, recent completions, pending reviews. Dedicated GET /api/pipeline-status endpoint (Andrei recommendation).
2. RT-38c (command palette): Alice targeting EOD March 19 for QA handoff. One day behind due to keyboard shortcut conflict (resolved).
3. Quick wins: Jonah builds pipeline-status endpoint, Enzo writes health smoke test, Robert audits spacing tokens, Andrei documents pipeline-log schema.
4. Forge review gates: 7 gates pending. Team requests CEO batch-approve to unblock.
